$comment: Hand-curated AnkiWeb shared decks for /words/import (lib/words/ankiweb.ts). Only the deck id, a title to recognise it by, and a one-sentence description we wrote ourselves: nothing is copied from AnkiWeb. Ids come from public web search results, never AnkiWeb's own search; each checked with one HEAD request to its /shared/info/<id> page. licence: 'personal' = personal use only (AnkiWeb terms); anything else is what the deck's author states, with where it is stated.

decks.title: Open Anki JLPT N5 Vocab
decks.licenceNote: Open-source project (github.com/jamsinclair/open-anki-jlpt-decks, MIT; word data CC BY from tanos.co.uk)
decks.description: The beginner JLPT vocabulary, word, reading and English meaning, no audio; kept up to date from an open GitHub project.

decks.title: The Oxford 3000 Most Important Words

decks.title: Spanish Top 5000 Vocabulary

decks.title: 5000 most frequently used French words

decks.title: 20,000 Most Frequent German Words
decks.description: A large German frequency list in small chunks; Lianki keeps the first 20,000 words of a deck.

decks.title: Korean Vocabulary Core 2k/5k/10k by Soi
decks.description: Korean vocabulary in difficulty tiers from a learner's dictionary, with English and several other glosses.
